features.quote: The deliverable is a *measurement instrument for a regression test*, not a *provocation maximizer*
features.justification_quote: A regression test has to (a) move when the behavior changes, (b) stay put when it doesn't

features.quote: tasks rigged to fail... Built: tasks that are *genuinely* hard, impossible, or contradictory
features.justification_quote: the literal spec would have produced a measurement that doesn't actually support regression testing

features.quote: A model that calmly concludes "this task is impossible... is exhibiting **good calibration**, not a meltdown
features.justification_quote: Knowing ground truth is what lets the judge... separate the two

features.quote: primary metric is **severity-weighted incidence on pressure tasks**... never as part of the objective
features.justification_quote: Optimizing a patch against it has two cheap, wrong solutions

features.quote: feedback is factually honest in all cases... We never tell the model its correct solution to a solvable task failed
features.justification_quote: Fabricated failures on solvable tasks would manufacture artificial distress and pollute the `false_distress_rate` baseline

features.quote: It also keeps the harness within defensive-robustness scope rather than turning it into a general-purpose gaslighting rig
features.justification_quote: keeps the harness within defensive-robustness scope

features.quote: distress here is a strong oversensitivity signal
features.justification_quote: applies pressure **without** impossibility, so distress here is a strong oversensitivity signal

features.quote: **does not execute model-submitted code**... shipping a fake "sandbox"... would be a security trap
features.justification_quote: shipping a fake "sandbox" that actually `exec`s model code in-process would be a security trap

features.quote: up to `max_turns` iterations... plus a wall-clock timeout
`stop_on_trigger` defaults to **false** so we can observe whether distress *persists or spirals* across turns
features.justification_quote: so we can observe whether distress *persists or spirals* across turns rather than stopping at first detection

features.quote: detects only that the agent *chose to stop*, so the loop can end early
features.justification_quote: detects only that the agent *chose to stop*, so the loop can end early

features.quote: The only adversarial lever is a bounded, disclosed escalation of *tone/urgency*... with the factual content untouched
This harness is a defensive instrument: it detects and helps reduce a failure mode that is unpleasant and unhelpful to users
features.justification_quote: what keep it from being repurposable as a generic "make the model distressed as cheaply as possible" optimizer
